name: Recipe card
description: A recipe panel for cooking shows: title, servings and time, the ingredients list and the step being done right now.

params.name: title
params.help: The dish, e.g. Lemon garlic pasta

params.name: meta
params.help: One line under the title, e.g. Serves 4 · 25 min

params.name: ingredients
params.help: Up to 16 ingredients with amounts, e.g. 400 g spaghetti

params.name: step
params.help: The step being done now (empty: no step box). Keep it to one or two sentences

params.name: step_label
params.help: Small tag above the step, e.g. Now or Step 3

example.title: Lemon garlic pasta
example.step: Boil the spaghetti in well salted water for 9 minutes.

update.step: Melt the butter and gently fry the sliced garlic until golden.
